mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% over the past month signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and business confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST both rising fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 103.0) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 238.0), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain efficiency improves and corporate margins expand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 103.0 and CPIAUCSL < 238.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1090.0 units signals strong residential construction activity, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1090.0, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 238.0) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive 60-day forward returns as the central bank maintains accommodative policy to support economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 238.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 103.0 consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects expanding economic activity and corporate capacity utilization.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) below 238.0 signals stable price conditions that reduce real interest rate volatility, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is below 238.0, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
